```{r setup, include=FALSE}

install.packages("flexdashboard")
library(flexdashboard)
install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("plotly")
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

```

```{r}
# Load and transform the data
data <- read_csv("AnnualData2024_clean.csv") 
data_long <- data %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = January:December, names_to = "Month", values_to = "Count")

# Widget 1: Line chart with hover tooltips
plot_ly(data_long,
        x = ~Month,
        y = ~Count,
        color = ~`Race_Ethnicity`,
        type = 'scatter',
        mode = 'lines+markers',
        hoverinfo = 'text',
        text = ~paste("Race:", `Race_Ethnicity`,
                      "<br>Month:", Month,
                      "<br>Count:", round(Count, 0))) %>%
  layout(title = "Monthly Trends by Race/Ethnicity",
         xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Count"))

```

```{r}
# Widget 2: Bar chart with sorting
data %>%
  arrange(desc(`Total for 2024`)) %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~reorder(`Race_Ethnicity`, `Total for 2024`),
    y = ~`Total for 2024`,
    type = 'bar',
    hoverinfo = 'text',
    text = ~paste("Total Count:", `Total for 2024`)
  ) %>%
  layout(title = "Total Count in 2024 by Race/Ethnicity",
         xaxis = list(title = "Race/Ethnicity"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Total Count"))

```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Load the data
data <- read_csv("AnnualData2024_clean.csv")

# Clean column names
colnames(data) <- str_trim(colnames(data))

# Define the section headers (as they appear in the CSV)
headers <- c("Age Category 1 ", "Age Category 2", 
             "Housing Status ", "Health Conditions", "Overdose Reversals ")

# Get row numbers of headers
header_rows <- which(data$Race_Ethnicity %in% headers)
header_rows <- c(0, header_rows, nrow(data) + 1)  # Add start and end boundaries

# Create a named list to store all charts
plots <- list()

# Function to create a bar chart widget for a category
make_widget <- function(df, category_name) {
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(`Total for 2024`)) %>%
    mutate(Race_Ethnicity = str_trim(Race_Ethnicity)) %>%
    arrange(desc(`Total for 2024`))
  
  plot_ly(
    data = df,
    x = ~reorder(Race_Ethnicity, `Total for 2024`),
    y = ~`Total for 2024`,
    type = 'bar',
    text = ~paste("Total:", `Total for 2024`),
    hoverinfo = 'text'
  ) %>%
    layout(
      title = paste("Total Count in 2024 by", category_name),
      xaxis = list(title = category_name),
      yaxis = list(title = "Total Count")
    )
}

# Create widget for Race/Ethnicity (manually since it's the first block)
plots[["Race/Ethnicity"]] <- make_widget(data[1:(header_rows[2]-1), ], "Race/Ethnicity")

# Loop through the rest of the categories
for (i in 2:(length(header_rows) - 1)) {
  cat_name <- str_trim(data$Race_Ethnicity[header_rows[i]])
  start <- header_rows[i] + 1
  end <- header_rows[i + 1] - 1
  subset_df <- data[start:end, ]
  plots[[cat_name]] <- make_widget(subset_df, cat_name)
}

# To display a specific chart, use for example:
plots[["Age Category 1"]]




```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Load the data
data <- read_csv("AnnualData2024_clean.csv")

# Clean column names
colnames(data) <- str_trim(colnames(data))

# Define the section headers (as they appear in the CSV)
headers <- c("Age Category 1 ", "Age Category 2", 
             "Housing Status ", "Health Conditions", "Overdose Reversals ")

# Get row numbers of headers
header_rows <- which(data$Race_Ethnicity %in% headers)
header_rows <- c(0, header_rows, nrow(data) + 1)

# Function to create a bar chart widget for a category
make_widget <- function(df, category_name) {
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(`Total for 2024`)) %>%
    mutate(Race_Ethnicity = str_trim(Race_Ethnicity)) %>%
    arrange(desc(`Total for 2024`))
  
  plot_ly(
    data = df,
    x = ~reorder(Race_Ethnicity, `Total for 2024`),
    y = ~`Total for 2024`,
    type = 'bar',
    text = ~paste("Total:", `Total for 2024`),
    hoverinfo = 'text'
  ) %>%
    layout(
      title = paste("Total Count in 2024 by", category_name),
      xaxis = list(title = category_name),
      yaxis = list(title = "Total Count")
    )
}

# Create a list of widgets
plots <- list()

plots[["Race/Ethnicity"]] <- make_widget(data[1:(header_rows[2]-1), ], "Race/Ethnicity")

for (i in 2:(length(header_rows) - 1)) {
  cat_name <- str_trim(data$Race_Ethnicity[header_rows[i]])
  start <- header_rows[i] + 1
  end <- header_rows[i + 1] - 1
  subset_df <- data[start:end, ]
  plots[[cat_name]] <- make_widget(subset_df, cat_name)
}

# 🎯 COMBINE all plots into one dashboard layout
dashboard <- subplot(
  plots,
  nrows = 3,  # adjust how many rows you want!
  margin = 0.05,
  shareX = FALSE,
  shareY = FALSE,
  titleX = TRUE,
  titleY = TRUE
)

# Display the dashboard
dashboard


```
